subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: After capability-safe behavior and live proof are established, should supported Copilot models automatically switch to native search, and should the shared wrapper become public Plugin SDK API?
rationale: The code defect can be described, but maintainers must choose whether existing users should change default search routing and whether third-party provider plugins may rely on this permanent API contract.

options.title: Capability-driven public seam
options.body: Use explicit provider capability data, preserve fallback for unknown models, and approve the generic helper as supported Plugin SDK API.

options.title: Capability-driven bundled seam
options.body: Implement the behavior for bundled providers but keep the shared helper outside the public Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Keep managed search default
options.body: Require explicit user opt-in before capability-confirmed Copilot models replace managed search with hosted search.

recommendation.title: Capability-driven public seam
recommendation.body: Use explicit provider capability data, preserve fallback for unknown models, and approve the generic helper as supported Plugin SDK API.

likelyOwner.reason: The direct OpenAI native-search behavior being generalized is tied to his current-main work, giving the strongest available signal for the default and API-boundary decision.
